items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So I told the bartender, I says, hey, that's Chu Berry. He said, you know him? I said, sure, I know him.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. So we said, well, we got a day off. Let's go down to the Elks' Home. So I said, okay, let's go to the Elks' Home, you know, you don't go there to buy ain't nothing just to go around have a ball. So we got down there and up against the wall behind the bar was Chu Berry's picture. So I told the bartender, I says, hey, that's Chu Berry. He said, you know him? I said, sure, I know him. But then you couldn't buy nothing.
